Stardust Strategic Assets, LLC

Operational Infrastructure & Private Holdings

Entity Profile

This entity creates the physical boundary between the public and the private. It holds the titles to the operational headquarters, the private residence, and the logistical fleet of the O'Connell Trust.

NOT OPEN TO THE PUBLIC. SOLICITATIONS REJECTED.

The Fortress

ID: PCC-01 (Residential)

512 Progress St NE. The private residence and historical point of origin. Maintained as a secure sanctuary.

Stardust Studios

ID: HQ-01 (Commercial)

Falling Branch Industrial Park. The Global Headquarters, Production Facility, and Secure Archives.

The Vault

ID: ARC-01 (Subterranean Cold Storage)

Climate-controlled Faraday archive beneath Stardust Studios housing 2-inch analog masters and the Sun-Ray Repatriation Catalog.

The Iron Horse & Fleet Archive

ID: FLT-01/02 (Heavy Touring & Shuttle Division)

The 2002 Sainte-Claire 45H3 interstate cruiser (60" hydraulic lift) and the 2004 Prairie Coachworks RLFD30 low-floor shuttle coach.

Corporate Governance

Stardust Strategic Assets, LLC is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Stardust Properties, LLC. Assets held by this entity are not available for lease or public use.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
